title: Supervised-failure node test can hang on unbounded entered.wait(); sibling has same gap
description: Wave-1 review (robustness, P3): python/tests/test_node.py:377 awaits entered.wait() with no timeout. If a regression makes the receive task terminate before invoking the patched link.receive (e.g. _send_expired_reassembly_aborts at node.py:808 raising a terminal-class error on first iteration), the supervisor stops the node, entered is never set, and the test hangs until job timeout with zero diagnostics. Wrap with asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), timeout=5) (style already used at line 390). NOTE: the pre-existing sibling test at line ~338 replicates the same pattern - same gap, same one-line fix, same file. Also (P3, same wave): test_atomic_batch_rejects_reserved_name_without_touching_other_targets asserts (st_dev, st_ino, st_mtime_ns) but omits st_ctime_ns unlike its sibling test - a chmod-only mutation would slip through; add st_ctime_ns. Discovered-from wave 1 beads project-LICHEN-worker6-wukp and project-LICHEN-worker6-blqw.
close_reason: Fixed in wave 1 follow-up: casefold guard + aliased regression, parametrize entry, fsync-ordering pin, hold-down constants, wait_for timeouts + ctime_ns. Suites green (44+178+130).
